about_the_game:
“I am one called Exile, and I wish to tell you a story.”

Battle, collect and upgrade dozens of Rogumon in this creature-collecting roguelite. Unique items, moves, and abilities ensure that no two attempts will be the same. Enter the fray alongside your team as you together seek to escape from the eternal prison of Torment.

Key Features

  • Build your team: Ally yourself with the Rogumon you encounter. Train them, teach them new moves, and find equipment to strengthen them.

  • Adapt to Torment’s shifting obstacles: No two escape attempts will be the same. You’ll be forced to experiment with – and fight against – different Rogumon on each run. With adaptability, quick thinking, and a little luck, you just might be able to create an unstoppable team.

  • Join the fight: Your Rogumon aren’t simply for you to command; you’re all fighting for your freedom together. Whichever character you choose will grant a passive to your whole team and can enter battle with powerful signature moves. Just be careful – if they go down in battle, you’ll be dragged down to the depths of Torment once more.

  • Build your strength: Initially, you’ll be ill-suited for the malice Torment holds. But, with each run, you’ll acquire new means of overcoming its challenges. Unlock new items, Rogumon, and other ways of strengthening your team. Perhaps you might even find a way to convince the fearsome bosses that oppose you to rally to your cause…

  • Develop relationships: Despite being cast from Paradise, you are certainly not alone – for better or for worse. Meet the other denizens of the afterlife, and learn more of their stories. Whether they wish to help you, hinder you, or both, you’ll discover more about them as you continue your escape attempts.

The journey will be difficult. The walls of Torment were not built to be breached. It’ll take all of your wits and a healthy dose of adaptability to be able to survive. And yet… there is hope. The Rogumon desire their freedom as much as you do, and they will join you if you call. Even the powerful foes who most fervently oppose you might be swayed, given enough time. Though you inevitably will fail, you’ll find the means to strengthen your team.

There is much to do. Let us begin.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 169 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game is not notarized and may not work with Catalina.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 169 MB available space
